description:
Test case 2 from the brief. The loan is set with the sliders, the schedule
  start month is changed in the calendar, and the year-wise bar chart is
  checked against an amortisation schedule computed in the test code.

elements.name: 10L personal loan at 12% for 5 years, starting June 2027

steps.name: I open the EMI calculator
I open the "Personal Loan" tab
I drag the sliders to a loan amount of 10L, an interest rate of 12% and a tenure of 5 years
I change the schedule start month to "Jun 2027"
the EMI, total interest and total payment match my own calculation
the payment schedule bar chart is visible
the bar chart has 6 bars, one for each year from 2027 to 2032
the tooltip of the 2028 bar shows the principal, interest and total payment from my own schedule

name: Personal loan payment schedule bar chart

description:
Test case 1 from the brief. The calculator's EMI, total interest and total
  payment should equal the reducing-balance formula worked out in the test
  code, and the pie chart should show both parts of the total payment.

steps.name: I open the EMI calculator
I open the "Home Loan" tab
I enter a loan amount of 25L, an interest rate of 10% and a tenure of 10 years
the EMI, total interest and total payment match my own calculation
the payment break-up pie chart is visible
both sections of the pie chart show values greater than zero
the pie chart splits the total payment into the principal and the interest I calculated
